summary: Frontend-only smoke test of Image-to-PDF Expo app on mobile web preview (390x844). Verified rendering, navigation, segmented-control selection + persistence, disabled-button states, and empty screens across Home (/), /settings, /settings-pdf, /selected, /result. All 7 screen-render / navigation / disabled-state assertions PASS. Camera pre-permission sheet cannot be validated on the web preview (expo-image-picker returns granted:true on web so the code path skips the sheet) — this is a native-only flow per the review note and is SKIPPED, not marked as a failure. No red-box errors, no fatal console errors.
verified_flows: Home renders: title 'Image to PDF', tagline 'Convert Images to PDF', Select Images, Take Photo, Recent PDFs section, 'No PDFs yet' empty state with image, settings gear (top-right).

Settings gear navigates to /settings; groups 'DEFAULT PDF SETTINGS' (Page Size A4/Original, Orientation Portrait/Landscape/Auto, Image Quality Standard/High/Best) and 'ABOUT' (Privacy Policy row, Developer 'Paul Digital', Version '1.0.0') visible; header-back-button returns to Home.

Segmented options select correctly (Page Size 'Original' and Quality 'Best' get white-background chip visible in screenshot). Persistence verified: navigated to Home and back to Settings, 'Original' and 'Best' remained selected (persisted via AsyncStorage 'pdf_defaults_v1').

/settings-pdf renders page-size, orientation, quality chips, pdf-name-input pre-filled with 'IMG_to_PDF_20260914_090644' matching /^IMG_to_PDF_\d+/, '.pdf' suffix visible, create-pdf-button DISABLED (aria-disabled=true, disabled=true) with 0 images.
/selected with no images shows 'No images selected' empty state and Go Back button; bottom bar shows 'Add More' and disabled 'Next' button (aria-disabled=true, disabled=true).
/result with no id shows 'PDF not found' and 'Return to Home' button (testID=result-home-button).
No red-box errors; only a benign non-fatal warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' in console (react-native-web internal, non-blocking).
skipped_native_only: AdMob banner/interstitial (native build only; returns null on web by design)

Take Photo pre-permission sheet ('Use the camera?') — on web, ImagePicker.getCameraPermissionsAsync() returns granted:true so the sheet code path is bypassed; on native Android with un-granted permission the sheet WILL appear (code review confirms the logic is correct).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx onTakePhoto flow is correct for native Android: permission not granted -> setCamSheet('explain') opens AppSheet with Continue/Not now. Sheet is not testable on web preview because expo-image-picker's web shim returns granted:true immediately; this is expected and documented in the review note.

Segmented components (both /settings and /settings-pdf) do not forward accessibilityState.selected to a data-* attribute — aria-selected is null in the DOM. Visual selection state renders correctly (verified via screenshots). Non-blocking but a testID-friendly aria-selected mapping would make automated selection assertions easier.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) present in the codebase. Uses expo-image, expo-image-picker, expo-file-system, expo-router — all current.
EXPO_PUBLIC_CONFIG_URL is empty as expected; app runs on DEFAULT_CONFIG safe defaults. fetchRemote() early-returns null when empty, so no network attempts on start.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 testable assertions pass; 1 flow skipped as native-only per review note)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Web-preview cannot exercise camera permission sheet, gallery picker, real PDF generation, or AdMob. All those must be validated on a native Android build. On the web the deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' comes from react-native-web internals and is safe to ignore.
